target_customer: Academic and industry life science labs analysing neuroscience and animal behaviour data without programmers
problem: Bench scientists spend months writing custom code to analyse fiber photometry, EEG and animal video data, and the analysis is inconsistent between labs.
business_model: SaaS subscription for no-code analysis tools

founders.name: Mehdi Boudjadja
education: University of Manchester, PhD in circuit neuroscience
founders.background_notes: Neuroscientist who built the tools after seeing labs struggle with large datasets; received a 2,000 GBP university Kickstarter grant per a Manchester profile.

founders.name: Salah Boudjadja
education: University of Paris Est, master's in programming, computer vision and signal processing
founders.background_notes: Data science, image processing and AI background.

competitors.name: GuPPy
competitors.what: Free open-source Python toolbox with GUIs for fiber photometry analysis
competitors.traction_then: Published in Scientific Reports Dec 2021; adoption not stated

competitors.name: PhAT
competitors.what: Open-source GUI toolkit for photometry analysis aligned to behaviour

technical_complexity.rationale: Standard signal processing and computer vision for rodent tracking, packaged as a web app; the hard part is validity across many lab setups, not novel research.

defensibility.rationale: Free open-source alternatives already existed and hardware vendors bundled analysis software; the niche is small and tools are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Hardware vendors sell their own photometry analysis suites; no source shows them targeting Metofico. No takeover reported.

market_need_then: Founders describe labs analysing complex datasets in a tedious, inconsistent way; open-source GUI tools appearing in 2021 to 2023 show demand for non-programmer analysis.

identity.logo: Wordmark in site header and footer; no further detail found

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand, no community or merch found. Customer-facing product names (TOMB-AI, FPA) carry more weight than the company name.

outcome_analysis: Metofico is an active two person London company from the Winter 2024 batch with a tiny reported raise and a niche scientific market. No exit or shutdown is reported, so the outcome is still open; the main risks are a small market and free academic tools, while strength is the founders' direct lab experience.
notes: Aggregators (VCBacked, Crunchbase, Extruct) cite about 500K USD total and disagree on pre-seed versus seed; amount seen only on aggregators so not recorded as a round amount. Round date from CB Insights convertible note April 2024. Outcome search found no news. No dated name origin found.
